tips.title: Define names of jobs or comments individually and automatically
tips.body: Select job parameters to define job names or comments.

tips.title: Use the Project Assistant for creating milling or MillTurn projects
tips.body: Follow step-by-step instructions to create a project in a simple and clear manner.

tips.title: Rollfeed Turning for machine turning parts
tips.body: Machine turning parts by rolling the tool insert on the component contour.

tips.title: 3D Optimised Roughing for adaptive pockets
tips.body: Optimised machining of adaptive pockets with large lateral but small vertical infeed and high feedrate.

tips.title: Smooth overlap option for slope dependent machining
tips.body: Optimise surface quality in the transition area between flat and steep areas with small retract movements.

tips.title: Extended coolant management for up to seven coolants
tips.body: Define additional coolants with unique IDs and allocate properties during post-processing.

tips.title: New Roll turn tool for rollfeed turning cycle
tips.body: Available in the new Rollfeed Turning cycle with four different insert types.

tips.title: Improved display of turning tools in tool database
tips.body: Display Setting length x and Setting length z for better visualization.

tips.title: External simulation support for COLLISION SAFEGUARD
tips.body: Support external simulation programs for collision safeguarding.

tips.title: Improved rest material display during machine simulation
tips.body: Display rest material in four steps based on maximum permissible rest material.

tips.title: Define stock size
tips.body: Set stock length, width, and height based on model dimensions and offsets.

tips.title: Set NCS position
tips.body: Choose between predefined Basic positions or Userdefined for the NCS.

tips.title: Create machining frames
tips.body: Define global clearance plane and create orthogonal frames relative to model or stock.

tips.title: Specify document settings
tips.body: Set units, directories, and feedback options in the hyperMILL Setup > Settings menu.

tips.title: Manage job settings
tips.body: Define joblist, milling/turning area, and stock names; select material and machine.

tips.title: Configure calculation settings
tips.body: Display temporary graphics, toolpaths, and erase existing paths during calculations.

tips.title: Check toolpath status
tips.body: Enable locking to prevent changes to elements like deletion and geometry change.

tips.title: Manage file paths
tips.body: Set default paths for saving files, including toolpaths, models, and databases.

tips.title: Define frames for NC system and frames
tips.body: In hyperMILL, define frames using elements like faces, planes, sketches, or coordinate systems directly in the graphics window.

tips.title: Set frame to current view
tips.body: Use the 'Set frame' option in hyperMILL for SolidWorks to set the frame based on the current view.

tips.title: Define frame with zero point and direction
tips.body: Specify the origin (X, Y, Z) and reverse the direction of axes as needed when defining a coordinate system.

tips.title: Use bounding box for frame positioning
tips.body: Position the coordinate system using a bounding box, adjusting its offset and color as needed.

tips.title: Define clamping position for simulation
tips.body: Set the clamping position to specify the zero point for simulations, using the machine model's upper edge middle point as a reference.

tips.title: Enable multiple origins for accuracy corrections
tips.body: Allow multiple origins in the joblist setup to make accuracy or tolerance corrections for specific areas of the part.

tips.title: Assign origin to a job for precise position adjustments
tips.body: Select the required origin from the list under Output origin or create/edit an origin in the Job definition's Transformation dialogue page.

tips.title: Use transformation for contour milling on 3D models
tips.body: Program a contour on one side of a cube and use transformations to machine the other sides automatically.

tips.title: Set workplane for transformations in the same plane
tips.body: Force jobs with transformations to switch to a different workplane if all transformations are in the same plane as the job frame.

tips.title: Generate graphical entities for coordinate system display
tips.body: Create non-associative CAD elements to display the coordinate system, which must be deleted and re-generated if the frame changes.

tips.title: Define base parameters for transformations
tips.body: Switch to the Frames tab and select a transformation from the shortcut menu in the Transformation area.

tips.title: Define manufacturing parameters for transformations
tips.body: Select the type of transformation and apply it in the job definition, selecting the Active checkbox.

tips.title: Use linear patterns in transformations
tips.body: Specify direction, structure (fixed distance or fit elements), and number of elements.

tips.title: Use circular patterns in transformations
tips.body: Define axis type (Points, Axis of cylinder or Line), pattern layout (Fit to total angle or Fixed step angle).

tips.title: Use general patterns in transformations
tips.body: Define target reference system (by frame or plane), specify name and comment.

tips.title: Mirror transformations for symmetry
tips.body: Ensure workpiece symmetry and use hyperMILL to calculate new toolpaths based on mirrored geometry.

tips.title: Mirror curve machinings in 2D Contour Milling, 3D Free Path Milling, and 5X Contouring cycles
tips.body: Choose between machining on the contour or at the side of the contour. Machining on the contour mirrors the curve including the start point for geometrically symmetric material removal.

tips.title: Define a mirror in hyperMILL
tips.body: Use Level, Three points, or Line and Point options to define a mirror. Select geometric elements and reverse the normal to face.

tips.title: Enable Copy option for job mirroring
tips.body: In the hyperMILL browser, a mirrored copy of the original element is created and associatively linked with the original.

tips.title: Break link between mirrored parameters
tips.body: In mirrored machinings, break the link between all parameters to the original job and adjust them individually.

tips.title: Mirror stock models in job list
tips.body: Select the mirror plane, enable the Copy option, and define the stock model for the mirror.

tips.title: Define a new tool in hyperMILL
tips.body: Right-click and choose New > [Tool type] from the shortcut menu, define all required parameters, and ensure a unique ID.

tips.title: Edit a document tool in hyperMILL
tips.body: Edit icons in the tool type dialogue allow for editing and saving document tools.

tips.title: Specify tool parameters for turning tools
tips.body: Select required parameter sets and define all required parameters in the Edit turning tool dialogue.

tips.title: Select a tool in a job
tips.body: Go to the Jobs tab, create a job, and select the Tool type and defined Tool.

tips.title: Enable 3D view for the tool
tips.body: In the Tools dialogue, enable the 3D view to visualize freely defined tool geometry.

tips.title: Define cutting parameters in the external tool database
tips.body: Parameters are defined on the Technology dialogue page.

tips.title: Select tool location based on corner radius
tips.body: For bullnose endmills, enable the function to base infeed distance on inner shank diameter.

tips.title: Use free tip geometry for collision check
tips.body: Enable the function to use free tip geometry for collision checking and simulation.

tips.title: Import tools from external database
tips.body: Select the required tool in the browser of the external OPEN MIND tool database.

tips.title: Filter tools for display restriction
tips.body: Define filter conditions in the General, Tool, Holder and Technology areas.

tips.title: Export tool to external database
tips.body: Select the tool and choose Export to tool database from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Unlink tool from external database
tips.body: Select the tool and choose Unlink / Unlink all tools from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Restore link to external tool database
tips.body: Select the tool and choose Relink / Relink all tools from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Edit external tool in document
tips.body: Unlink the external NC tool, make changes, and update only the tool stored in the document.

tips.title: Update external tool with data from database
tips.body: Use the shortcut menu function to update linked tool with data from the external database.

tips.title: Export tools to XML file
tips.body: Select the tools and choose Export.../ Export all... from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Display warning messages for tools
tips.body: Select the tool and choose Messages... to display stored warnings.

tips.title: Open job definition with double-click
tips.body: Double-click the Job ID or Job name to open the job definition.

tips.title: Select appropriate contours for machining
tips.body: Lines, circles, polylines, splines, graphics loaded in omx for mat (Contour Milling, Pocket Milling and Helical Drilling). Points can be used for drill positions.

tips.title: Ensure no large gaps between adjacent surfaces
tips.body: Large surface gaps can cause unwanted nose-diving of the cutter during machining.

tips.title: Avoid overlapping surfaces for rest material removal
tips.body: Overlapping surfaces can result in unwanted rest material areas that cannot be removed by the Automatic Rest Material cycle.

tips.title: Define stock models for collision checking
tips.body: Stockmodels in STL or VIS format can be defined for various machining operations.

tips.title: Check updated stock models for collisions
tips.body: The updated stock model is checked for collisions to ensure both tracked and calculated stock models are collision-free.

tips.title: Define stock models using various methods
tips.body: Stockmodels can be defined through Extrusion, Rotation, Surfaces, From job, File, Bounding geometry, or Cast offset.

tips.title: Select appropriate units for stock models
tips.body: Please note that hyperMILL cannot display stock files larger than 25 MB.

tips.title: Generate turning stock models from milling stock models
tips.body: hyperMILL allows you to generate a stockmodel for turning jobs from a stock-model for milling jobs and vice versa.

tips.title: Define stockmodels using STL or VIS format
tips.body: Select a file in *.STL or *.VIS format for stockmodel creation.

tips.title: Use global offset for entire stockmodel
tips.body: Select 'Global offset' to apply an offset to the entire stockmodel.

tips.title: Optimize stock model generation in 5X machining
tips.body: Ensure the Cutting length parameter is defined in the tool definition for optimized stock model generation.

tips.title: Mirror stock models using the shortcut menu
tips.body: Select 'Mirror stock' from the shortcut menu to create mirrored stock models.

tips.title: Create compound stock models for multiple components
tips.body: Right-click the stock browser and select 'New compound stock' to merge multiple stockmodels.

tips.title: Edit stock models using the Edit stock function
tips.body: Select 'Edit stock' to split or clean selected stockmodels.

tips.title: Create stock chains for sequential machining steps
tips.body: Select 'Stock > Create stock chain' to generate stock models based on previous job toolpaths.

tips.title: Save stock models in VIS format
tips.body: Select 'Save stock file as' and choose *.vis format to save stockmodels.

tips.title: Calculate stock models using the shortcut menu
tips.body: Select 'Calculate' from the shortcut menu to calculate selected stockmodels.

tips.title: Define joblist structure
tips.body: Organize CAM projects using joblists and compound jobs for extensive projects.

tips.title: Export joblists
tips.body: Select joblist, choose export options, and specify file name and path.

tips.title: Import joblists
tips.body: Load *.jst file, enable import options, and select include tools/geometry.

tips.title: Set joblist parameters
tips.body: Configure joblist settings before calculating toolpaths, including names and origins.

tips.title: Define stock models
tips.body: Create stock models for multiple jobs in a joblist.

tips.title: Set material for machining
tips.body: Select the required material for machining purposes in the joblist.

tips.title: Configure NC file settings
tips.body: Set machine, NC directory, and naming method for NC files.

tips.title: Enable vector fine interpolation
tips.body: Default is enabled; set maximum permissible angle change for machine movements.

tips.title: Optimize rapid mode for 5X machining
tips.body: Select optimized option to avoid pole pass and high acceleration of C axis.

tips.title: Create a new job
tips.body: Use the New function on the browser's shortcut menu and specify settings on all dialogue pages.

tips.title: Transfer job parameters
tips.body: Use the Copy and Paste functions on the shortcut menu to transfer parameters between jobs.

tips.title: Define job-specific details
tips.body: Enter a name, comment, and ID in the Job information section of the General dialogue page.

tips.title: Use name patterns for jobs and comments
tips.body: Select parameters from the Job, Frame, Tool, Machining or Parameter areas to create dynamic name patterns.

tips.title: Configure colours for visualisation
tips.body: Set colours for rapid tool movements, infeed movements, collisions, and tool axis.

tips.title: Enter user-defined text blocks in NC dialogue
tips.body: Use the Use this function to enter control instructions or other parameters, ensuring the machine can interpret the data correctly.

tips.title: Define a compound job
tips.body: Combine any 2D, 3D or 5X jobs into a compound job for clear structuring and improved product flexibility.

tips.title: Define a linking job
tips.body: Combine multiple jobs into a linking job for optimised approach and retract movements, collision monitoring, and improved machining times.

tips.title: Linking of 3D and 5-axis jobs
tips.body: It is possible to link 2D cycles such as Pocket Milling and Rest Machining in 5X mode.

tips.title: Specify the mode for linked individual jobs
tips.body: Modes include Skip first and last, Keep all rapids.

tips.title: Use min. dist. G0 for linked jobs
tips.body: Movements between jobs are executed as a direct link between pairs of contour points in G1.

tips.title: Specify clearance mode for linking jobs
tips.body: Options include Planar and Radial.

tips.title: Clearance radius X for rapid tool movements in X direction
tips.body: Radius is specified in the Clearance settings.

tips.title: Clearance plane Z for rapid tool movements in Z direction
tips.body: Plane is specified in the Clearance settings.

tips.title: Clearance distance for linking movements in X direction
tips.body: Distance is specified in the Clearance settings.

tips.title: Rapid smoothing for Clearance distance retract mode
tips.body: Enable High speed option to activate Rapid smoothing.

tips.title: Linking movements with Distance angle limit must match rapid smoothing
tips.body: Ensure consistency between the two settings.

tips.title: Enable stock for collision-checked rapid link movements
tips.body: Select the checkbox to define a collision-checked stock model.

tips.title: Transformation for linking jobs
tips.body: The current transformation is executed by calculating the linking job and all copies are linked to collision-checked rapid link movements.

tips.title: Example of use for linking jobs
tips.body: Complete machining of a closed pocket with inclined walls in 5X linking mode without a tool change.

tips.title: NC events for job flow and programming control
tips.body: Use NC events to structure the program flow and influence programming by entering commands, joblists, and jobs.

tips.title: Multi-Axis Indexing prerequisites
tips.body: Requires a machine with C axis and/or swivelling milling head, and a 3D model drawing.

tips.title: Programming always takes place in the G17 workplane
tips.body: Infeed in negative Z direction; Z axis is perpendicular to the machining side.

tips.title: Defining machine cycles in a job sequence
tips.body: Job sequence is arbitrary, but tool change optimization can be done one page at a time for shorter calculation times.

tips.title: NC events cannot be simulated or checked for collisions
tips.body: Postprocessing is only possible in package mode during NC Event usage.

tips.title: Global editing for multiple jobs
tips.body: Edit job definition parameters for multiple jobs at the same time.

tips.title: Edit a parameter by double-clicking the corresponding line
tips.body: Jobs using this parameter are shown as a tooltip when moving the mouse over a parameter.

tips.title: Create an associative job copy
tips.body: A job copy is associatively linked with the original job, and changes in the original job are reflected in the copy.

tips.title: Unlink the copied job and original job
tips.body: Select the copied job in the hyperMILL browser and select the Unlink associative copy function.

tips.title: Unlink associative job copy
tips.body: Right-click relevant parameter, select Unlink to deactivate the associative link between the original job and its copy.

tips.title: Recalculate job with associative copy
tips.body: If recalculating a job with an associative copy, the copy will also be recalculated.

tips.title: Edit job parameters
tips.body: Parameters can be edited together for multiple jobs or joblists using Global editing.

tips.title: Create stock chain
tips.body: Select jobs in a joblist or compound jobs to create a stock chain.

tips.title: Update stock models
tips.body: Calculate or update stockmodels based on the preceding model and current job toolpath.

tips.title: Generate NC file
tips.body: Perform a postprocessor run for the selected entry (job/joblist) to generate an NC file.

tips.title: Start internal simulation
tips.body: Use Internal simulation to simulate the toolpaths and machine movements.

tips.title: Start internal machine simulation
tips.body: Use Internal machine simulation to simulate the toolpaths and machine movements with real-time machine dynamics.

tips.title: Show toolpaths in Toolpath Edit cycle
tips.body: In the Toolpath Edit cycle, use Show tool to display the current tool being used.

tips.title: Define milling area
tips.body: Select a milling area in the CAD model to define the machining region for collision checking.

tips.title: Exclude areas from milling
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to exclude specific areas within the milling area from being machined.

tips.title: Set turning area
tips.body: Define a contour for collision-checked turning area in hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Define clamping area
tips.body: Select surfaces or a solid for the clamping area in hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Set resolution for turning area
tips.body: Define the resolution (fineness) of the turning area in hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Define allowance for fixture area
tips.body: Set the allowance for the clamp in hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Use hyperMILL Converter for collision check
tips.body: Convert CAD models to 3DF files using the hyperMILL Converter.

tips.title: Set mathematical resolution for conversion
tips.body: Specify the maximum chordal height for curve segments in G1 lengths.

tips.title: Define groups for different resolutions
tips.body: Select surfaces with different mathematical resolutions and stock allowances.

tips.title: Set maximum facet length for groups
tips.body: Define the maximum facet length within the 3DF model for each group.

tips.title: Select surfaces for conversion
tips.body: Choose solids or surfaces to be converted in the hyperMILL Converter.

tips.title: Save existing 3DF file during conversion
tips.body: Option to save the existing 3DF file under a different name or add new surfaces.

tips.title: Ensure correct job sequence
tips.body: The sequence of jobs in the job list should match the machining order.

tips.title: Check job definitions for errors or warnings
tips.body: Before calculating a toolpath, check jobs with error or warning notifications using the Messages function.

tips.title: Milling area required for 3D and 5-axis machining
tips.body: A milling area must be present to calculate a toolpath for 3D and 5-axis machining.

tips.title: Units of measurement are fixed after job, tool, and frame definition
tips.body: Changes to the measurement system are not permitted after defining jobs, tools, and frames.

tips.title: Calculate toolpaths directly in job definition or hyperMILL browser
tips.body: Toolpaths can be calculated either directly in the job definition for an individual job or in the hyperMILL browser for multiple jobs or all jobs in a joblist.

tips.title: Jobs with errors should be checked before post-processing
tips.body: Jobs that ended with an error should only be post-processed after a thorough check.

tips.title: NCS must be identical for all jobs within a job list
tips.body: The NCS (program zero point) must be the same for all jobs in a job list to avoid invalidating previously calculated jobs.

tips.title: Ignore messages during toolpath calculation
tips.body: During the calculation, you can choose to ignore messages and calculate the job, ignore all messages for all jobs, cancel the calculation, or edit the settings.

tips.title: Continuous addition of toolpaths to CAD file
tips.body: If specified in the job list settings, generated toolpaths are continuously added to the CAD file.

tips.title: Display of collisions during toolpath calculation
tips.body: If the system identifies collisions while calculating toolpaths, they are also displayed graphically.

tips.title: Update calculated toolpaths for specific cycles
tips.body: Changes to the feedrate, spindle RPM, or comment do not require a full recalculation of the job for certain cycles.

tips.title: Edit toolpaths using a boundary
tips.body: To edit toolpaths using a boundary, select the job to be edited in the hyperMILL Browser and choose New > Toolpath edit.

tips.title: Use min. dist. G0 for safe and efficient toolpath linking
tips.body: Unnecessary rapid link movements are avoided by setting the minimum distance for G0 movements.

tips.title: Collision check available for specific tool types
tips.body: Collision check is currently available for Ball mill, End mill, and Bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Edit toolpaths using a boundary for joint management
tips.body: Changes in the original job are reproducible with the same settings in the editing cycle when editing toolpaths using a boundary.

tips.title: Simulate machining using hyperVIEW, internal simulation, or external simulation programs
tips.body: Options for simulating machining include hyperVIEW, internal simulation, and external simulation programs like VERICUT.

tips.title: Start internal simulation from the hyperMILL browser
tips.body: To start the internal simulation, select the required joblist or job and choose Internal Simulation from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Control simulation speed and tool display options
tips.body: Set the simulation speed using 50 steps and configure the tool display options in the internal simulation.

tips.title: Generate images of the tool at the current position during simulation
tips.body: You can generate an image of the tool at the current position and delete it using the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Start the toolpath viewer for detailed analysis
tips.body: The toolpath viewer displays the complete toolpath in G0/G1 steps, allowing precise analysis of individual tool movements.

tips.title: Define stop conditions for simulation
tips.body: Open the dialogue to define stop conditions such as stopping at job change during a simulation of multiple jobs.

tips.title: Simulate to the beginning of the first job
tips.body: You can start the simulation from the beginning of the first job in a joblist.

tips.title: Start reverse simulation or step back during simulation
tips.body: You can start a reverse simulation, step back, or continue the simulation as needed.

tips.title: Enable machine cone shape interpolation
tips.body: To ensure that cone shape interpolation is used in simulations, enable this option.

tips.title: Change machining variant for 5-axis or inclined machining
tips.body: Open the Machine structure dialogue to specify the Plane for rotation angle C axis.

tips.title: Display machine components during simulation
tips.body: Open the Setup collision check dialogue to define which machine components should be displayed.

tips.title: Use transparent display for stock/model/fixture
tips.body: In the Machine Structure dialogue, enable the option to display the defined stock/model/fixture in a transparent manner.

tips.title: Enable automatic adjust for variable counterholder (tailstock)
tips.body: In the Setup collision check dialogue, enable the Automatic adjust option to move the clamping position along 3 axes.

tips.title: Use detailed point distance to NCS
tips.body: Enable the respective measure function in the Measuring section to display detailed point distances from the X/Y/Z axis of the defined NCS.

tips.title: Simulate material removal for machining steps
tips.body: Start the material removal simulation to simulate complete material removal based on the currently calculated or assigned stock.

tips.title: Display rest material after machining
tips.body: Use the Rest material display function to show the remaining rest material after machining.

tips.title: Set stop conditions for simulation
tips.body: Open the dialogue to define stop conditions such as stopping at job change, tool change, collision, or end of machine limit.

tips.title: Use internal machine simulation for collision check
tips.body: Check toolpaths for collisions using machine models in the internal machine simulation.

tips.title: Enable stock checks for collision detection
tips.body: Check 'G0 stock collision' to ensure tool components are checked for collisions in rapid machining mode during milling jobs.

tips.title: Set simulation tolerance for precision
tips.body: Adjust 'Simulation tolerance' in the Setup dialogue to control the precision of elements used in the simulation.

tips.title: Change tool definition during simulation
tips.body: Select 'Tool from job' in the Tool mode to use a different tool for simulation without recalculating the toolpath file.

tips.title: Set up machine for simulation
tips.body: Choose 'Automatic centre' or specify a manual setup point in the Setup dialogue to position the model on the machine table.

tips.title: Display toolpaths during simulation
tips.body: Click 'Display toolpaths' to show or hide the current toolpath in the material removal simulation.

tips.title: Switch collision check on during simulation
tips.body: Click 'Switches the collision check on' to enable collision checks based on settings in the Setup collision check dialogue.

tips.title: Configure VERICUT for collision safeguarding
tips.body: Follow steps in the 'Configuring VERICUT / COLLISION SAFEGUARD' section to set up VERICUT for external simulation and collision detection.

tips.title: Specify VERICUT project settings
tips.body: Define the directory and name of the VERICUT project file (*.vcproject) in the 'Output project' section.

tips.title: Generate NC files during VERICUT project creation
tips.body: Check 'Generate NC files' to automatically trigger the postprocessor run and generate an NC file while creating the VERICUT project data.

tips.title: Run VERICUT after project data generation
tips.body: Click 'Run VERICUT' to generate the VERICUT project data and start the simulation.

tips.title: Start analysis from the hyperMILL Tools > Analysis menu or Utilities > Analysis shortcut
tips.body: Click the icon to start the Analysis.

tips.title: Select surfaces for analysis in transparent mode
tips.body: Click the surface(s) that you want to analyze.

tips.title: Save analysis results on a freely specifiable layer
tips.body: Click the icon to define the layer and enter the name.

tips.title: Filter concave/convex/undercut radii
tips.body: Select the relevant options in the Filter section.

tips.title: Write planes/radii on separate layers
tips.body: Right-click in the list display and select 'All selected on/All selected off'.

tips.title: Specify machine model for analysis
tips.body: Select the machine model in the Setup section.

tips.title: Set up the CAD model automatically at the centre of the machine table
tips.body: Select 'Automatic centre' in Setup point mode.

tips.title: Align tool at the frame or surface normal
tips.body: Use the left mouse button to position the tool.

tips.title: Optimize tool length based on current position
tips.body: Click the 'Optimise tool length' button.

tips.title: Copy tool to job after optimization
tips.body: Click the icon to copy the optimized tool to the job.

tips.title: Export geometry data in OMX format
tips.body: Select the contours and click 'Export OMX'.

tips.title: Import WinTool tools into hyperMILL
tips.body: Select the OMX file and click 'Import'.

tips.title: Export Zoller tools from hyperMILL
tips.body: Click 'Export ZOLLER tools' and select the joblist.

tips.title: Change contour size
tips.body: Select surface edges and offset them using hyperMILL Tools menu.

tips.title: Link adjacent contours
tips.body: Use hyperMILL Tools menu to link contours with a specified tolerance.

tips.title: Wrap side shell
tips.body: Use hyperMILL Tools menu for wrapping or unwrapping a label on a side shell.

tips.title: Wrap tread
tips.body: Use hyperMILL Tools menu for wrapping or unwrapping a profile pattern.

tips.title: Convert grid to NURBS
tips.body: Use hyperCAD for converting grids into NURBS curves.

tips.title: Boundary recognition
tips.body: Use hyperCAD for selecting external contours with a specified tolerance.

tips.title: Extract circles and arcs
tips.body: Use hyperCAD for extracting circles and arcs from contours.

tips.title: Read toolpath
tips.body: Use hyperMILL for reading toolpaths from existing jobs.

tips.title: Delete hyperMILL graphical data
tips.body: Use hyperMILL in Inventor for deleting temporary tool graphics.

tips.title: Prepare CAD models for machining
tips.body: Use hyperCAD utilities like placing erroneous surfaces on a layer, closing surfaces, splitting solids, changing entity properties, thickening planes, and exporting parameters.

tips.title: Define feature parameters using geometric elements
tips.body: Feature parameters can be defined by selecting geometric elements in the CAD model.

tips.title: Use feature filters to control visibility of features
tips.body: Open the feature filter by clicking the icon on the toolbar and select the type of geometric elements for the filter definition.

tips.title: Assign a frame to a feature list for job definition analysis
tips.body: If a feature from this feature list is used for the job definition, the frame of the feature list is analysed.

tips.title: Sort features in the feature browser by type, name or number
tips.body: Use the drop-down menu on the left to sort the features in the browser according to Type, Name or Number.

tips.title: Define attributes for geometric elements in the feature editor
tips.body: Click on the icon to change geometric elements with attributes, such as orientation, offset, vector, boundary, contour, length, surface, plane.

tips.title: Link features with the current job using the Feature Job Connector
tips.body: Features linked to the job are listed in the Feature Job Connector. Click on the icon to open the Select feature dialogue to link a feature with the current job.

tips.title: Use formulas to define geometric parameters of features
tips.body: Formula: Various geometric parameters of the features can be defined using a formula. All basic calculating operations are permitted as arithmetic expressions.

tips.title: Define feature names and classes
tips.body: Name features for clarity, use feature classes to organize related features.

tips.title: Select feature types and orientations
tips.body: Choose appropriate feature types (2D contour, 3D contour, T-slot, Point) and define their orientation.

tips.title: Define surface groups for machining
tips.body: Specify surfaces and strategy types for Surface Group features in job definitions.

tips.title: Define planes for machining operations
tips.body: Set plane parameters for Plane features in job definitions.

tips.title: Define T-slot parameters
tips.body: Specify slot height, width, throat dimensions, and tolerances for T-slot features.

tips.title: Use generic pockets for versatile machining
tips.body: Utilize Generic Pockets for universal machining, with options for rectangle, circle, groove shapes.

tips.title: Use generic holes for complex machining needs
tips.body: Employ Generic Holes for various hole types, including counterbore, countersink, and undercut.

tips.title: Define bottom types for generic holes
tips.body: Specify bottom types (through, flat, tip) and their parameters for Generic Hole features.

tips.title: Define parameters for Simple Hole feature
tips.body: Orientation, group, position, chamfer, chamfer depth, diameter, depth, bottom chamfer, bottom type, offset bottom, tip angle, ISO fit, fit value, fit length.

tips.title: Define parameters for Sink Hole feature
tips.body: Orientation, group, position, chamfer, depth, core hole diameter, core hole depth, bottom type, offset bottom, tip angle, ISO fit, fit value, fit length, thread.

tips.title: Define parameters for Free defined Hole feature
tips.body: Orientation, group, position, ISO fit, ISO fit offset, thread, thread offset, bottom type, offset bottom, number of steps, step type, diameter, depth, angle.

tips.title: Define parameters for Pocket feature
tips.body: Orientation, contour, wall angle.

tips.title: Define parameters for Surface feature
tips.body: Surface, strategy type.

tips.title: Define parameters for Compound Feature
tips.body: Frame, frame origin, frame orientation, sub features.

tips.title: Define parameters for Turbomachinery Feature
tips.body: Blade surfaces, bottom plane, hub curve, shroud surface.

tips.title: Define feature and macro technology
tips.body: Under General, specify the required Name and Class of the feature. Select geometric elements in the Feature parameter area.

tips.title: Use Customised Process Feature (CPF) for machining
tips.body: To use a CPF, the models must have common geometric characteristics, specify the machining sequence in the job list, and link geometric elements with job parameters.

tips.title: Define CPF structure in hyperMILL
tips.body: Switch to the Feature tab, right-click and select New > Customised Process Feature > Machining object. Name the CPF according to the machining planned.

tips.title: Link CAD data to CPF
tips.body: Right-click the feature browser and open the CPF dialogue. Select New > Customised Process Feature > [CPF name]. Assign required parameters such as Orientation, Surfaces, Profiles, and Milling area/stock.

tips.title: Use CPF in job definition
tips.body: Switch to the Feature dialogue page and select the corresponding CPF. Deactivate unused parameters by double-clicking in the lower area of the Feature job connector.

tips.title: Re-use CPF with modified CAD data
tips.body: Save the joblist, jobs, and CPF as a template file. Insert new CAD model using hyperCAD menu Insert > From file. Update filter definition(s) to transfer data correctly.

tips.title: Automate feature creation using Feature Mapping (Hole)
tips.body: Switch to the Feature tab, select Feature Mapping (hole) function in the shortcut menu. Set tolerance and options such as Check slot, Slot tolerance, and Diameter limit.

tips.title: Use preferred machining direction
tips.body: Combine all holes that can be machined from a defined direction into a single feature list.

tips.title: Set offset angle for preferred machining direction
tips.body: Default offset angle is 0.5°. Adjust based on the specific requirements.

tips.title: Check sink during feature generation
tips.body: Enable to ensure the sink can be machined from the defined direction.

tips.title: Define machining direction for features
tips.body: Click on the icon and select a geometric element or enter vectors manually.

tips.title: Set feedback position for preferred machining direction
tips.body: Define the origin of graphical feedback by clicking on a geometric element or entering coordinate values manually.

tips.title: Use feature list for drillings
tips.body: If enabled, drillings are saved as features in existing feature lists based on frames assigned to these lists.

tips.title: Select frame creation mode for features
tips.body: Options include 2D, 5X, Mixed, and Split by Diameter.

tips.title: Check machinability during feature generation
tips.body: Enable to recognize only accessible areas as features.

tips.title: Use colour table for feature properties
tips.body: Enable the Use colour table option to recognize thread, ISO fits, or feature classes from a colour table.

tips.title: Define thread properties in colour table
tips.body: Specify R, G, B values and fit/designation for each feature property.

tips.title: Set minimum tip angle for hole recognition
tips.body: Define the angle from which holes can be recognized as through or tip type.

tips.title: Create associative point for hole features
tips.body: Display and edit point coordinates of hole features relative to a selected frame.

tips.title: Group features with same geometry
tips.body: Summarize features with the same geometry to a feature for each frame.

tips.title: Recognize features from CAD model
tips.body: Use hyperMILL's Feature Recognition modules for interactive detection of geometric feature information.

tips.title: Define sample hole for recognition
tips.body: Select a base hole to define parameters for recognizing other holes.

tips.title: Select surfaces for sample hole recognition
tips.body: Choose all surfaces of the base hole for manual definition or select a surface for automatic recognition.

tips.title: Assign features to existing feature list
tips.body: Use the Move to featurelist function to select an existing feature list or create a new one.

tips.title: Define thread properties for feature-based macros
tips.body: Specify thread form, designation, diameter, pitch, type, and length.

tips.title: Select holes with same parameters
tips.body: Compare hole surfaces with base hole and recognize those with matching parameters.

tips.title: Filter holes by color, layer, orientation, and angle
tips.body: Use filters to limit hole recognition based on color, layer, orientation, and frame angle.

tips.title: Search for holes using CAD window selection
tips.body: Utilize the Window selection function in CAD to search for holes, especially useful in complex models.

tips.title: Collect holes with same parameters in a feature
tips.body: Holes with the same direction and depth are collected into a single feature.

tips.title: Define tolerance for curve resolution in holes
tips.body: Set the required tolerance of the curve resolution for hole features.

tips.title: Use solid info for drill feature direction
tips.body: Activate the 'Use solid info' option to copy the direction of drill features from the CAD model.

tips.title: Create features from recognized planes
tips.body: Recognized planes can be converted into features with specified top and bottom heights.

tips.title: Recognize pockets with bottoms, through pockets, open and closed pockets, and T-slots
tips.body: Pockets of various types can be recognized using manual or automatic surface selections.

tips.title: Combine pockets into complex pockets
tips.body: Automatically combine individual pockets into a single complex pocket for efficient processing.

tips.title: Manually combine pockets using the feature browser
tips.body: Combine pockets manually via the shortcut menu or color table in the feature browser.

tips.title: Combine pockets using Combine Pockets function
tips.body: Highlight pockets in feature browser, select Combine Pockets, define colours in Colour table dialogue.

tips.title: Reverse pocket direction manually
tips.body: Double-click or right-click to reverse pocket direction.

tips.title: Use slot profile as contour during contour milling
tips.body: Pocket Recognition checks if pocket meets slot conditions, use slot profile as contour.

tips.title: Use slot ends as drill points during drilling
tips.body: Pocket Recognition checks if pocket meets slot conditions, use slot ends as drill points.

tips.title: Create new job for slot milling
tips.body: Create a new job (2D Contour Milling) using Pocket feature, define tool diameter and On contour option.

tips.title: Select two wall surfaces for open through pockets
tips.body: For open through pockets, select two non-parallel wall surfaces or one uneven surface.

tips.title: Limit pocket size using tool diameter
tips.body: Pocket filters allow limiting pocket size based on tool diameter.

tips.title: Check accessibility in direction of surface normals
tips.body: Accessibility check is performed in the direction of surface normals and opposite direction.

tips.title: Define approach length for pocket accessibility
tips.body: Approach length defines minimum distance between potential bottom plane and other surfaces.

tips.title: Use colour table for feature recognition
tips.body: Pocket bottoms with specific colour values are automatically recognised and assigned to corresponding feature classes.

tips.title: Define geometric elements for boundary recognition
tips.body: Select curves/surfaces to generate a boundary.

tips.title: Use 'Auto' for automatic selection of contour elements
tips.body: Automatically add the next contour element with the largest change in direction.

tips.title: Edit a feature in the Feature editor
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click and select Edit to make changes.

tips.title: Select additional features using the Feature selector
tips.body: Drag desired feature into the right window and confirm with OK.

tips.title: Reverse feature orientation for through holes and pockets
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, and select Reverse hole or Reverse pocket.

tips.title: Create a new frame on a selected feature
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, and select New frame on feature.

tips.title: Replace a Simple Hole with a Sink Hole
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, and select Replace by Sink Hole.

tips.title: Fit a hole to stock model geometry
tips.body: Select the hole features and right-click, select Fit hole to stock model.

tips.title: Disconnect the job-feature link
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, and select Disconnect.

tips.title: Adjust hole features to stock model geometry manually
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, select Manual and define adjustments.

tips.title: Specify a higher tolerance value for hole features
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, select Tolerance and specify a higher value.

tips.title: Check milling area when generating hole features
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, select Check milling area and enable.

tips.title: Find intersecting holes and compile them into a feature
tips.body: Select the Generic Hole, right-click, select Find intersecting holes.

tips.title: Save model tolerance as a default value
tips.body: Select the feature, right-click, select Save as default.

tips.title: Create a new feature list
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Create a new feature list.

tips.title: Start feature mapping for holes
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Feature Mapping (Holes).

tips.title: Start Single Hole Recognition dialogue
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Single Hole Recognition.

tips.title: Open Pocket / T-Slot Recognition dialogue
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Pocket / T-Slot Recognition.

tips.title: Start Plane Recognition dialogue
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Plane recognition.

tips.title: Create a Contour feature
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Contour.

tips.title: Create a Strategy Curve feature
tips.body: Select Feature lists, click Strategy Curve.

tips.title: Define macro rules using feature parameters and formulas
tips.body: Feature parameters and formulas can be used to define macro rules in hyperMILL.

tips.title: Use Copy and Paste rule functions to transfer macro rules
tips.body: Copy rule to clipboard / Paste rule functions on the macro shortcut menu can be used to copy and paste macro rules between different macro jobs.

tips.title: Update macros from the database
tips.body: The Update macro from database function updates the selected macro with parameters from the macro database.

tips.title: Save changes to the macro database
tips.body: The Save changes to database function saves parameters of the selected macro to the macro database.

tips.title: View the macro database
tips.body: The View macro database function displays the macro database.

tips.title: Calculate toolpaths for selected jobs
tips.body: The Calculate function calculates the toolpath(s) for the selected job(s).

tips.title: Simulate toolpaths using internal simulation
tips.body: The Internal simulation function simulates the toolpath(s) using the internal simulation.

tips.title: Check toolpath status for selected geometry
tips.body: The Set toolpath status function checks whether the toolpath is still current for the geometry.

tips.title: Show, hide, or delete toolpaths of selected job
tips.body: The Toolpaths > Show / Hide / Autoshow / Delete function controls the visibility and deletion of toolpaths.

tips.title: Check model consistency for assigned contours
tips.body: The Check model function checks the consistency of the contours assigned to the job.

tips.title: Delete selected macro
tips.body: The Delete function deletes the selected macro.

tips.title: Expand or collapse jobs linked to selected macro
tips.body: The View > Expand / Collapse function hides or shows the jobs linked to the selected macro.

tips.title: Expand or collapse all jobs in macro browser
tips.body: The View > Expand all / Collapse all function shows or hides all the jobs in the macro browser.

tips.title: Define contours for turning operations
tips.body: Contours may correspond to the contour of the turning model.

tips.title: Set start and end points for machining
tips.body: Start point / endpoint: define the start and end points for machining, either by selecting a point or by entering coordinates.

tips.title: Invert machining direction of the selected contour
tips.body: Reverse: Invert the machining direction of the selected contour.

tips.title: Define free angle for tool insert
tips.body: Free angle: Defines the minimum angle to be maintained between the tool insert and the calculated toolpath.

tips.title: Set infeed direction for machining
tips.body: Infeed direction: To left / To right: Machining is performed from right to left or from left to right in the direction of the axis of the turning surface.

tips.title: Enable chipbreak Z for flexible adjustment
tips.body: Chipbreak Z: Enable this option to control the chip break and chip removal in combination with the Dwell time or Rotations parameters.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for rapid movements
tips.body: Clearance distance (1): clearance movement at feedrate before the rapid movement begins.

tips.title: Set clearance radius for rapid tool movements in X direction
tips.body: Clearance radius (X): Radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction.

tips.title: Define additional allowances for Z and X directions
tips.body: Additional allowance Z (2): Allowance in Z direction. Additional allowance X (3): Allowance in X direction.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros
tips.body: Approach macro/Retract macro: Additional movement during infeed to the first path or during retraction after the last path.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for toolpath
tips.body: The ramp angle (1) refers to the turning axis (2), taking the infeed direction into account.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for right and left sides
tips.body: Stock trimming can be defined separately for the right and left sides.

tips.title: Define a closed, planar contour for turning models
tips.body: Contour must be in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Enable collision check for tool safety
tips.body: Check option to permanently ensure no collisions with stockmodel and turning model.

tips.title: Create turning area from model surfaces or solids
tips.body: Use 'Create turning area from model' dialogue to generate a turning area.

tips.title: Select a frame for the turning axis
tips.body: Choose from list to define the orientation of the turning axis.

tips.title: Define resolution for turning area
tips.body: Set the fineness of the turning area contour.

tips.title: Create turning stock from existing models
tips.body: Select a turning stock model and create a milling stockmodel for subsequent jobs.

tips.title: Define infeed direction for machining
tips.body: Choose 'To left' or 'To right' to specify the direction of machining.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Specify the minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract.

tips.title: Define additional movement during approach or retract
tips.body: Use macros to add extra movements during approach or retract.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for infeed direction
tips.body: Calculate the ramp angle based on the infeed direction and contour.

tips.title: Trim stock on the right and left sides
tips.body: Define separate trimming for right and left sides of the workpiece.

tips.title: Create a milling stock model from turning stock
tips.body: Highlight the corresponding turning stock model in the browser and select the Create milling stock function from the shortcut menu. Specify the required resolution and click OK to confirm.

tips.title: Define turning stock model
tips.body: A turning model is defined on the basis of a closed, planar contour that is located in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Set up turning model parameters
tips.body: Specify a name and, if necessary, a comment for the turning area. Generate a turning area by selecting a closed contour.

tips.title: Define turning stock parameters
tips.body: Specify a name and, if necessary, a comment for the turning stock. Enable a mode that is to be used to create the turning stock.

tips.title: Collision check for turning stock
tips.body: If this option is selected, the holder of the tool used is permanently checked for potential collisions against the current stockmodel and the current turning model.

tips.title: Select start and end points for machining
tips.body: Either by selecting a point or entering coordinates.

tips.title: Assign segments of a contour cutting speed and feedrate
tips.body: To reduce tool wear and improve surface quality.

tips.title: Define contact parameter for roll turn tools
tips.body: For X Full Roll Turn and X Short Roll Turn inserts, define using Roll start contact and Roll end contact parameters.

tips.title: Set macro clearance for tool movements
tips.body: Minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Define approach macro/retract macro for additional movement
tips.body: During infeed to the first path or during retraction after the last path.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for tool movements
tips.body: Refers to the turning axis, taking the infeed direction into account.

tips.title: Define turning model for machining operations
tips.body: Based on a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Enable collision check for tool usage
tips.body: Permanently checks the holder of the tool used against potential collisions.

tips.title: Define turning stock based on a closed, planar contour
tips.body: In the X-Z plane of the turning frame and associated turning axis.

tips.title: Create milling stock from turning stock
tips.body: Any turning stock represented in the hyperMILL model browser can be used.

tips.title: Use Synchronisation lines for B axis movement
tips.body: Set the movement profile of the B axis.

tips.title: Adjust offset angle for insert orientation
tips.body: If the insert is not aligned parallel to the tool holder.

tips.title: Select machining direction for 3X simultaneous Roughing
tips.body: Outside (1) / Inside (2): The external shape of a workpiece is created by using the Outside option and the internal shape by using the Inside option.

tips.title: Define infeed for machining operations
tips.body: Constant: Constant infeed depth (1) over the entire machining area.

tips.title: Define macro clearance for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements. If the tool is closer, a macro is generated automatically.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for rapid movements
tips.body: Clearance movement at feedrate before the rapid movement begins.

tips.title: Define clearance radius for rapid tool movements in X direction
tips.body: Radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for rapid tool movements in Z direction
tips.body: Plane for rapid tool movements in the Z direction.

tips.title: Define retract plane for tool withdrawal from undercutting areas
tips.body: Activating the Radial / Axial limit option in combination with the Retract plane (Z) parameter makes it possible to drive out the tool from the undercutting areas.

tips.title: Set minimum and maximum B angle for tilting of the B axis
tips.body: Use Min. B angle and Max. B angle to define the permissible angle range for the tilting of the B axis.

tips.title: Define rapid angle for approach, retract or both
tips.body: Transition mode: Define a Rapid angle for the rapid movement.

tips.title: Select contours for turning operations
tips.body: Contours: Define contours for turning operations.

tips.title: Define start and end points for machining
tips.body: Start point / endpoint: define the start and end points for machining.

tips.title: Select cutting side for machining
tips.body: Inside (1) / Outside (2): The external shape of a workpiece is created by using the Outside option.

tips.title: Enable falling contours allowed
tips.body: Contours in the X direction are machined (1). Function disabled (2).

tips.title: Set machining mode for selected areas
tips.body: Limit machining to selected areas.

tips.title: Select edge behaviour of the tool
tips.body: Control the edge behaviour of the tool.

tips.title: Increase retraction feedrate for certain machining strategies
tips.body: The retraction feedrate can be increased for all machining stra tegies for which retraction occurs without a ramp movement.

tips.title: Define ramp angle for plunging into the stock model
tips.body: Ramp angle (1): Angle of the ramp when plunging into the stock model.

tips.title: Set radial compensation value for final finishing
tips.body: Radial deviation from the model contour in final finishing.

tips.title: Define radial infeed for material removal
tips.body: Infeed in radial direction (cutting depth).

tips.title: Set maximum infeed depth for material removal
tips.body: Maximum depth of the material removal in radial direction.

tips.title: Define radial and axial limits for machining
tips.body: Limits the machining area of the tool used in the radial or axial direction.

tips.title: Set axial infeed depth
tips.body: Axial infeed (1): Infeed in axial direction (cutting depth). Max. infeed depth (2): Maximum depth of the material removal in axial direction.

tips.title: Set clearance for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Macro clearance: Minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Set clearance radius for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Clearance radius (X): Radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for the right and left sides
tips.body: Stock trimming can be defined separately for the right and left sides.

tips.title: Set retraction feedrate for machining strategies
tips.body: Increase the retraction feedrate for all machining strategies without a ramp movement.

tips.title: Enable path compensation for tool radius calculation
tips.body: When this option is activated, path compensation is handled by the controller.

tips.title: Define machining mode for selected areas
tips.body: Limit machining to selected areas with a slope angle.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros for finishing
tips.body: Additional movement during infeed to the first path or during retraction after the last path.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for smooth transitions
tips.body: The ramp angle refers to the turning axis, taking the infeed direction into account.

tips.title: Define tangential approach and retract macros for finishing
tips.body: Additional options for tangential length, arc angle, arc radius, and tangential extension.

tips.title: Define turning model
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Enable collision check
tips.body: Select the option to permanently check for potential collisions between the tool and stockmodel.

tips.title: Define turning stock
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame and associate it with the turning axis.

tips.title: Set frame for turning axis
tips.body: Select a frame from the list that aligns with the tool's rotary axis.

tips.title: Define contour attributes
tips.body: Specify start and end points for machining, either by selecting a point or entering coordinates.

tips.title: Select machining strategy
tips.body: Choose between radial roughing and radial roughing with ramp for turning operations.

tips.title: Set infeed direction
tips.body: Choose between bottom and top for infeed direction relative to the axis of the turning stock.

tips.title: Select cutting mode
tips.body: Choose between oneway and zigzag for machining orientation.

tips.title: Define radial/axial limit
tips.body: Limit the machining area of the tool in both radial and axial directions.

tips.title: Set clearance distance
tips.body: Define the minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Define axial compensation value
tips.body: Compensate for axial deviation due to tool deflection factors like feedrate, cut depth, and workpiece material.

tips.title: Set dwell time
tips.body: Specify the dwell time of the tool in revolutions or seconds.

tips.title: Define macro clearance
tips.body: Set the minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Set clearance radius
tips.body: Define the radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction.

tips.title: Set clearance plane
tips.body: Define the plane for rapid tool movements in the Z direction, available for Inside machining and Plane options.

tips.title: Define model allowance
tips.body: Set global allowances on the model, additional allowances in X and Z directions.

tips.title: Define macros for retract behavior
tips.body: Use a ramp to modify retract behavior, defining the Ramp angle and Ramp length.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for right side
tips.body: Set stock trimming parameters separately for the right and left sides.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for left side
tips.body: Set stock trimming parameters separately for the right and left sides.

tips.title: Increase retraction feedrate for strategies without ramp movement
tips.body: For all machining strategies where retraction occurs without a ramp, increase the retraction feedrate.

tips.title: Grooving is performed parallel to the axis of the turning stock
tips.body: Grooving strategy involves machining parallel to the axis of the turning stock.

tips.title: Inside/Outside option for external/internal shapes
tips.body: Use 'Outside' for external shapes and 'Inside' for internal shapes.

tips.title: Define radial and axial limits for machining area
tips.body: Set limits in the radial and axial directions to control the machining area.

tips.title: Set clearance distance and radius for rapid movements
tips.body: Define the clearance distance and radius for rapid tool movements in X and Z directions.

tips.title: Specify dwell time for tool and units
tips.body: Set the dwell time of the tool using revolutions or time units.

tips.title: Use pecking to remove chips efficiently
tips.body: Plunge and retract the tool in alternating manner until total radial infeed is reached.

tips.title: Set macro clearance for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Ensure the tool does not touch the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Enable collision check for tool and stock models
tips.body: Permanently check the tool against potential collisions with the current stockmodel.

tips.title: Define turning stock for machining operations
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Generate stock models for subsequent operations
tips.body: Create stockmodels based on the current turning job or a combination of milling and turning jobs.

tips.title: Set frame for machining operations
tips.body: Ensure the Z axis of the machining frame is the same as the rotary axis of the tool.

tips.title: Change reference side during machining
tips.body: The reference side of the recessing tool changes (left/right) during machining.

tips.title: Set axial offset for pre-plunge
tips.body: Pre-plunge the tool at the transition from axial to radial direction to prevent engaging with two sides simultaneously.

tips.title: Use up and down cutting for vertical walls
tips.body: Material is removed with up and down movements to avoid collision between tool holder and stockmodel geometry.

tips.title: Define additional allowances for X and Z directions
tips.body: Additional allowance in X and Z directions can be specified to ensure proper machining.

tips.title: Create macros for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Macros can be used to define additional movement during infeed or retraction.

tips.title: Define tangential approach and retract macros
tips.body: Tangential approach and retract macros can be defined with additional options for length, arc angle, and radius.

tips.title: Trim stock according to the contour selected
tips.body: Stock trimming can be defined separately for the right and left sides using axial or tangential methods.

tips.title: Define turning model for the parting tool
tips.body: A turning model is defined on a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Select reference side for toolpath calculation
tips.body: The insert side used as a reference can be either left or right, depending on the position of the insert on the tool holder.

tips.title: Define parting strategy based on insert position
tips.body: The machining strategy is determined by the parting tool definition, with options for front or back face.

tips.title: Set machining mode for parting off
tips.body: Options include normal, retract clearance distance, or retract to clearance radius.

tips.title: Use pecking for multiple passes
tips.body: Pecking can be enabled with a defined plunge depth and overrun in X direction.

tips.title: Define additional allowance for Z direction on parting side
tips.body: Additional allowance in Z direction can be specified to ensure proper machining on the parting side.

tips.title: Set clearance for parting operations
tips.body: Information on setting clearance for parting operations is provided in the section on Clearance.

tips.title: Define turning model for parting operations
tips.body: A turning model is defined on a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Generate turning stock from existing mill stock
tips.body: Select base stock and use the Create milling stock function to generate a new model.

tips.title: Define thread cutting tool parameters
tips.body: Select the contour for the Thread outer edge and specify Core diameter or Nominal diameter.

tips.title: Set infeed strategy for thread cutting
tips.body: Choose from One cut, Constant chip section, Constant X infeed.

tips.title: Define machining area for thread cutting
tips.body: Specify the finish allowance for remaining offset on the thread turn.

tips.title: Set drilling strategy
tips.body: Choose from Centering, Simple Drilling, Drilling with Chip Beak, etc.

tips.title: Define drilling mode
tips.body: Select between 2D Drilling, 2D multi-axis drilling, and Turning mode.

tips.title: Select drill positions using contours
tips.body: Choose lines or points to define Top and Depth of the drill hole.

tips.title: Use relative values for drill hole dimensions
tips.body: Define Top and Depth using Absolute, Top of contour, Bottom of contour, or Relative to the top.

tips.title: Define drill hole diameter
tips.body: Diameter: Define the required diameter of the drill hole.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for individual drill holes
tips.body: Additional distance: Clearance distance for an individual drill hole when collision check is disabled.

tips.title: Use selected contour for Top and Depth of drill hole in 2D multi index drilling
tips.body: Lines: The selected contour (line) automatically defines the Top and Depth of the drill hole.

tips.title: Define drill position and direction using selected points and surfaces in 5X Drilling
tips.body: Points (and surfaces): Set the drill position with the selected points and surfaces and set the direction using the frame.

tips.title: Reverse the direction of drill hole in all contour selections
tips.body: Reverse: The defined direction of the drill hole can be reversed in all contour selections.

tips.title: Specify start and end of machining in Z direction for outer line contour selection
tips.body: Outer line: The start and end of machining in the Z direction and the machining diameter are specified by defining a contour (outer line).

tips.title: Project base point onto turning axis if it does not lie on the turning axis
tips.body: Base point: The start of machining in the Z direction is specified with the definition of a base point. If the base point does not lie on the turning axis, it is projected onto the turning axis automatically.

tips.title: Define start point for circular drilling strategy
tips.body: Start: Use start reference: Define any point as the start point.

tips.title: Consider Z height of selected drill holes during optimisation in circular drilling strategy
tips.body: Z-Optimisation: The Z height of the selected drill holes is taken into account during optimisation.

tips.title: Define machining direction for segments in circular drilling strategy
tips.body: Orientation: The parameters for controlling orientation relate to the machining of the segments.

tips.title: Define radial width for circular drilling strategy
tips.body: Radial width (1): Width of a circle segment, measured from the centre of the machining area.

tips.title: Define centre point for circular drilling strategy
tips.body: Centre point: In order to obtain a correct toolpath calculation, it is essential to define a centre point.

tips.title: Define segment width for X / Y parallel drilling strategy
tips.body: Segment width (A): Width of a segment extending in the X or Y direction.

tips.title: Define maximum segment gap for contour parallel drilling strategy
tips.body: Max. segment gap: Value of the maximum distance between two subareas of the same surface.

tips.title: Define maximum drilling point gap for contour parallel drilling strategy
tips.body: Max. drilling point gap: Value of the maximum possible distance between two drilling points.

tips.title: Define move B axis first or C axis first for 5X drilling optimisation
tips.body: Move B axis first / Move C axis first: Control the grouping of drill holes and thus specify the machining sequence.

tips.title: Define bottom offset for machining area in drilling
tips.body: Bottom offset: The drill depth is reduced by the specified amount.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for hole security in drilling
tips.body: Clearance distance (1): This distance holds the tool to a theoretical edge of the unchamfered hole.

tips.title: Define break through length for drilling
tips.body: Break through length: Extends the toolpath in the axial direction.

tips.title: Define tip angle compensation for drilling
tips.body: Tip angle compensation: Available for all drilling cycles except Centring, Helical Drilling, Thread Milling and Circular Pocket.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for drilling cycles
tips.body: J:Ft variable sets the Clearance plane to the height of the highest selected feature relevant for machining.

tips.title: Configure retract mode for drilling cycles
tips.body: Available options include Clearance plane and Clearance distance.

tips.title: Enable rapid smoothing for multiple-sided machining
tips.body: Activate Rapid smoothing by selecting the High speed option.

tips.title: Define drilling depth using stop surfaces
tips.body: Limit the depth of drill holes using stop surfaces, which can be positive or negative.

tips.title: Set pecking depth for drilling with chip break
tips.body: Enter the stepdown of the tool in the first drilling stroke and reduce value for subsequent strokes.

tips.title: Configure reaming parameters
tips.body: Set feedrate for retraction and dwell time as short as possible.

tips.title: Define boring parameters
tips.body: Input parameters similar to Simple Drilling, including rapid and feedrate.

tips.title: Set helical drilling parameters
tips.body: Define pitch, groove depth, chamfer length, and spindle RPM for helical drilling.

tips.title: Configure chamfer angle for helical drilling
tips.body: Values between 0 and 89.99° are advisable.

tips.title: Set allowances for helical drilling
tips.body: Define roughing and finishing allowances XY, and bottom offset.

tips.title: Use ball mills, end mills, bullnose end mills, and thread mills for thread milling
tips.body: These tools can be used to produce single and multiple inside and outside threads.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for drilling
tips.body: Clearance distance (1): This distance holds the tool to a theoretical edge of the unchamfered hole.

tips.title: Adjust break through length for drilling
tips.body: Break through length (4): Extends the toolpath in the axial direction.

tips.title: Select thread type for threading operations
tips.body: External thread (1)/Internal thread (2): Select the desired thread type.

tips.title: Define thread pitch for threading operations
tips.body: Pitch (3): enter thread pitch.

tips.title: Set retract distance for drilling operations
tips.body: Retract distance: Dimension of the axial distance between the top of the drill hole and the retract movement to the clearance plane.

tips.title: Use circular macro for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Approach radius /retract radius : approach and retract movements to/from the contour are performed in a circular movement.

tips.title: Define horizontal stepover factor for circular pocketing
tips.body: Horizontal stepover factor: Infeed in the XY plane is defined as a factor of the tool diameter (< 1).

tips.title: Enable tool data storage for compensated centre path
tips.body: Tool data storage: D-0.5 / R-0.25 - The tool diameters must be adhered to exactly during machining.

tips.title: Set dwell time for drilling operations
tips.body: Dwell time: Time in seconds for which the drill remains on the hole bottom to cut material free.

tips.title: Enable step-by-step feedrate increase for drilling operations
tips.body: To increase feedrate values between F1 and F2, F6 and F2 as well as F4 and F2, activate the option step-by-step feedrate increase.

tips.title: Set coolant off in crosshole for drilling operations
tips.body: Coolant off in crosshole: Enable this option to switch off the coolant at the start of crosshole drilling and to switch it back on again at the end of crosshole drilling.

tips.title: Define linking movement parameters for drilling operations
tips.body: Distance angle limit: Difference of angle value for different tool inclinations between two different machining areas.

tips.title: Set clearance straighten angle
tips.body: If the angle between the Z axis of the current machining frame and Z axis of the tool is greater than the defined Straighten angle (default = 45°), the tool turns to the defined value for the Straighten angle. If the angle is smaller than or equal to the defined Straighten angle, the tool moves to the clearance plane without changing the tool inclination.

tips.title: Define stock model for deep hole drilling
tips.body: To recognise breakthroughs and/or crossholes, you need to define a stock model within the Optimised deep Hole Drilling cycle.

tips.title: Set machining area parameters
tips.body: Specify offset for the start of the Helical Drilling (Offset top), material remaining on the machining base (Bottom offset), and values for top and bottom refer to the origin of the defined frame (Absolute top / Absolute bottom).

tips.title: Configure reposition feedrate
tips.body: Set the feedrate of the tool during repositioning between infeed planes (Reposition feedrate) or radial intermediate steps.

tips.title: Define lead angle for helical drilling
tips.body: The lead angle (Lead angle) is the angle by which the tool is tilted in the infeed direction, relative to the tangent on the helical toolpath.

tips.title: Set hole collision avoidance parameters
tips.body: If the option is active, collision avoidance occurs around the A/B axis. First, the tilt angle is reduced. If this is not sufficient, the lead angle is reduced as well.

tips.title: Select machining contours for 2D operations
tips.body: The following can be selected as 2D machining contours: points (drilling only), arcs, circles, reference lines, curves and curves of surfaces.

tips.title: Define machining parameters for pocket milling
tips.body: Pocket Milling: Machining perpendicular pocket walls and adaptive pockets with automatic island recognition and calculation of rest material areas.

tips.title: Define machining parameters for contour milling
tips.body: Contour Milling: Milling open and closed 2D contours with optional path compensation and different approach and retract strategies.

tips.title: Define machining parameters for chamfer milling
tips.body: Chamfer Milling on 3D Model: Machining of prismatic workpieces. It is possible to differentiate between the Modelled chamfer and Deburr / chamfer sharp edges machining strategies.

tips.title: Define machining parameters for plunge milling
tips.body: Plunge Milling: Guided by a contour, the cycle generates a Plunge Milling toolpath. Possibility to perform collision control and stock update.

tips.title: Specify relative dimensions
tips.body: Use relative dimensions for drawings with Z information, where top is at Z=0 and bottom is based on the geometry.

tips.title: Set infeed parameters
tips.body: Define vertical stepdown, lateral stepover factor, and stock allowances for machining.

tips.title: Configure clearance settings
tips.body: Select a clearance plane and define a clearance distance for rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Define plunge points
tips.body: Set plunge points for each pocket or use automatic plunge point for optimal machining start.

tips.title: Use open areas in pockets
tips.body: Define open areas within pockets and link the job with a Pocket feature for machining.

tips.title: Avoid collisions with plunge points
tips.body: Ensure that user-defined plunge points do not cause collisions and are collision-checked.

tips.title: Machining from the outside in
tips.body: In stock mode, machining always proceeds from the outside in to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Define plunge points by selecting a reference job
tips.body: Prerequisites: High Performance Mode enabled, frame's Z axis orientation matches pocket machining.

tips.title: Sort contours by shortest distance for optimal traversal
tips.body: Available in 2D, 3D, and Stock mode.

tips.title: Use adaptive pockets for efficient rectangular and circular pocket machining
tips.body: Available in 2D mode and Stock model mode.

tips.title: Adjust feedrates and infeed for adaptive pocket machining
tips.body: Parameters include Fillet radius, Radius for horizontal infeed, and Fillet all toolpaths.

tips.title: Select climb milling for clockwise rotating tools in pocket contours
tips.body: Clockwise for island contours, counterclockwise for pocket contours.

tips.title: Set safety parameters for repositioning
tips.body: Default value: Clearance distance * 0.1.

tips.title: Adjust infeed for dense areas
tips.body: Factor Dense area stepover (factor) is multiplied by Stepover.

tips.title: Enable opening cut for narrow, inaccessible areas
tips.body: Adjust vertical stepdown and feedrate based on machining situation.

tips.title: Adjust entry feedrate for hard materials
tips.body: Factor side entry regulates the lateral approach from outside.

tips.title: Set plunge feedrate for inaccessible pockets
tips.body: Min. Enablefeedrate specifies a minimum value.

tips.title: Adjust zigzag feedrate for climb milling
tips.body: Factor influencing the opposite direction feedrate.

tips.title: Restrictions for High Performance Mode
tips.body: Corner fillet radius, plunge points, Use adaptive pocket option, G2/G3 movements.

tips.title: Set retract mode to retraction plane
tips.body: Default value for retract mode.

tips.title: Use only Ramp or Helical plunge macro
tips.body: Helix radius calculated automatically.

tips.title: Use vertical plunge macro for stepdown without material removal
tips.body: For soft materials like aluminium, plastics, or existing predrilled holes.

tips.title: Set helix radius for vertical plunging with a tool suitable for vertical chip removal
tips.body: Offset of the cutter centre point relative to the axis of the helix (Z axis through infeed point).

tips.title: Use ramp plunging for soft free cutting in tight spaces
tips.body: Ramping-in proceeds along the first milling path.

tips.title: Adjust spindle RPM and dwell time for plunge macro
tips.body: Spindle speed changes take place during the dwell time before and after the plunge macro.

tips.title: Select cutter types for contour milling
tips.body: Ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, chamfered cutter and T-slot cutter.

tips.title: Specify contour attributes for machining
tips.body: Top, bottom, start point, end point and plunge point parameters.

tips.title: Enable overlap for closed contours in contour milling
tips.body: Tool path will move the tool past the start point until it reaches the given end point.

tips.title: Set plunge point for infeed to the first work plane
tips.body: Cutter moves directly from the plunge point to the starting point or to the approach macro position.

tips.title: Reverse machining direction for selected contours
tips.body: Change the cutter position if the generated toolpaths do not result in the intended machining direction.

tips.title: Align closed contours simultaneously
tips.body: Change the machining direction for all selected closed contours.
