tips.title: Connect adjacent contours with one another
tips.body: Use the Connect contours function from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Adapt feedrate for individual contour elements
tips.body: Centre, Edge control, Segments options available.

tips.title: Set cutting speed for individual contour areas
tips.body: Select segment and click the link icon for cutting speed or feedrate.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate based on factors
tips.body: Select segment, click the link icon and enter the required factor directly.

tips.title: Select cutter position for contour milling
tips.body: Left, Right, On contour options available.

tips.title: Enable centre path for toolpath calculation
tips.body: Select this function if your controller does not offer the path compensation feature.

tips.title: Set stock allowance for contour milling
tips.body: Stock allowance XY and Allowance (lateral infeed area) add up for 2D Contour Milling.

tips.title: Enable interior corners for smooth filleting
tips.body: Smooth filleting (rounding) of internal milling paths for contour pockets or islands.

tips.title: Reduce corner feedrate for sharp corners
tips.body: Feedrate reduction occurs when the angle between the current and changed direction is greater than or equal to 60°.

tips.title: Define macro position for On contour tool position
tips.body: Left or Right can be defined as the macro position; Left is standard, and Right is also standard.

tips.title: Set feedrate for Approach and Retract
tips.body: The feedrate may be defined for both Approach and Retract in hyperMILL.

tips.title: Define vertical milling area
tips.body: Top / Bottom: Use Top of contour / Bottom of contour or Absolute (jobframe) to define the upper and lower limits for machining.

tips.title: Set preferred start, end, and plunge points
tips.body: Specify the preferred start point, end point, and plunge point parameters for Contour Milling.

tips.title: Enable additional allowance for contours
tips.body: Define a horizontal (X, Y) and vertical (Z) allowance for each individual contour.

tips.title: Connect adjacent contours
tips.body: Select the Connect contours function to connect selected contours with one another.

tips.title: Define overlap length for closed contours
tips.body: Use the Overlap length to define the distance that the tool should travel beyond the start point for closed contours.

tips.title: Optimise start points for closed contours
tips.body: A search is automatically performed to find the best starting points that will facilitate a collision-free standard macro.

tips.title: Sort contours for soft machining
tips.body: Contours are sorted in such a way that the linking fast travel movements (rapids) are as short as possible.

tips.title: Assign feedrate to segments of a contour
tips.body: Click the Edit segments button to assign a feedrate to segments of a contour.

tips.title: Define vertical machining area in Surface mode
tips.body: Use Top of surfaces / Bottom of surfaces or Absolute (jobframe) to define the upper and lower limits for machining.

tips.title: Set overlap length for closed contours in Surface mode
tips.body: Use the Overlap length to define the distance that the tool should travel beyond the start point for closed contours.

tips.title: Set infeed for Contour Milling
tips.body: Oneway or Zigzag can be selected for the infeed.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate reduction for zigzag infeed
tips.body: Feedrate reduction of the counter movement by one factor value when machining with zigzag infeed.

tips.title: Define machining sequence for Contour Milling
tips.body: Bottom or Plane can be selected for the machining sequence.

tips.title: Smooth filleting of internal milling paths
tips.body: Fillet interior corners: Smooth filleting (rounding) of internal milling paths for contour pockets or islands.

tips.title: Reduce corner feedrate for interior corners
tips.body: Interior corners are machined at a reduced feedrate.

tips.title: Define behaviour of the tool at outer edges
tips.body: Roll, Extend, or Loop-like extension and threading at edges can be defined.

tips.title: Contour Milling on 3D Model Contours
tips.body: hyperMILL calculates a toolpath that can be machined using the specified tool without collisions, taking into account stock allowances in XY.

tips.title: Compensated Centre Path
tips.body: Only available if enabled on the Setup dialogue page for the job-list. hyperMILL calculates a toolpath that can be machined using the specified tool without collisions, including path compensation.

tips.title: Finish Only Last Level
tips.body: A finish pass is performed on the lowest level.

tips.title: Spring Path
tips.body: For closed contours, an additional finish pass is performed for each Z level, which removes fine machining cavities, thus increasing the surface quality.

tips.title: Prefer Spiral Infeed
tips.body: Wherever possible, there is a spiral infeed to the next machining pass.

tips.title: Axial Clearance / Lateral Clearance
tips.body: Minimum distance in an axial or lateral direction from the surface of the machined part.

tips.title: Boundary
tips.body: Specify the horizontal limit of the machining area.

tips.title: Stop Surfaces
tips.body: Define the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Offset
tips.body: The offset of the stop surfaces extends the area excluded from machining by the specified value.

tips.title: Trim to Milling Area
tips.body: The milling area defined on the Setup dialogue page is used to trim the toolpaths.

tips.title: Trim to Stock
tips.body: The stock defined on the Setup dialogue page is used to trim the toolpaths.

tips.title: Use Min. Trimming Distance
tips.body: Enable to avoid unwanted retract movements. If the section length is smaller than or equal to the min. trimming distance, the toolpath is trimmed.

tips.title: Macro Mode
tips.body: Automatic: By default, a collision-free, tangential macro is attempted. Manual: Several options are available for the approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Macro Position
tips.body: Left / Right: The macro movement takes place to the left or right of the tool, from the perspective of the contour.

tips.title: Feedrate Macros
tips.body: The feedrate may be defined for both Approach and Retract.

tips.title: Tool Reference Points
tips.body: The tool reference point can be disabled, set to Tip, or set to Disc top.

tips.title: Specify contours for T-slot cutting
tips.body: Create separate contours for each side of the T-slot to machine a complete slot.

tips.title: Set tool position for T-slot cutting
tips.body: Select 'On contour' or 'Left/Right' tool positions based on the direction of the contour.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate for individual contour elements
tips.body: Use 'Centre', 'Edge control', or 'Segments' options to adapt the feedrate.

tips.title: Define allowance for T-slot cutting
tips.body: Enter values for 'Allowance XY', 'Allowance top', and 'Allowance bottom'.

tips.title: Set axial and lateral infeed areas
tips.body: Enter values for 'Max. axial step', 'Total infeed', and 'Max. lateral step'.

tips.title: Configure retract mode for T-slot cutting
tips.body: Select 'Clearance distance' or 'Clearance plane' and define the clearance values.

tips.title: Use macros for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Select 'Perpendicular', 'Quarter circle', 'Tangential', or 'Half circle' macro modes.

tips.title: Auto climb tool position parameters
tips.body: Left and Right parameters are not available for Auto climb tool position.

tips.title: On contour tool position macro positions
tips.body: Either Left or Right can be defined as the macro position for On contour tool position.

tips.title: Default tool positions for Left and Right
tips.body: Left macro position is activated as standard (and cannot be changed). Right macro position is activated as standard (and cannot be changed).

tips.title: Chamfer Milling on 3D Model machining strategies
tips.body: Facilitates safe and rapid machining of prismatic workpieces with two strategies: Modelled chamfer and Deburr/chamfer sharp edges.

tips.title: Chamfer mode parameters
tips.body: Modelled chamfer: height defined by model geometry. Deburr/chamfer sharp edges: height defined on Parameters dialogue page.

tips.title: Inclined Contouring parameters
tips.body: Wall angle, vertical stepdown, allowance XY/Z.

tips.title: Inclined pocketing parameters
tips.body: Wall angle, rectangular pockets, contours, offset, pre-machining allowance.

tips.title: Rectangular pocket machining parameters
tips.body: Vertical stepdown, horizontal stepover factor, allowances, clearance distance.

tips.title: Tool rest machining parameters
tips.body: Vertical stepdown, horizontal stepover factor, allowances, clearance distance.

tips.title: Face Milling parameters
tips.body: Machining mode, vertical stepdown, horizontal stepover factor, allowances, clearance distance.

tips.title: Face Milling infeed mode
tips.body: Zigzag direct, Zigzag smooth, One-way.

tips.title: Face Milling overlap parameters
tips.body: Consider corner radius, fit step.

tips.title: Specify Z value of playback contour
tips.body: Set the Z value for the playback contour in the dialog box.

tips.title: Set perpendicular infeed X/Y
tips.body: Adjust the intersection degree of the toolpath based on the tool diameter (0.2 > 20%).

tips.title: Enable collision avoidance
tips.body: Activate collision avoidance to ensure the tool retracts while considering model offsets.

tips.title: Select tool for plunge milling
tips.body: Choose a suitable cutter type (ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill) for plunge milling.

tips.title: Define infeed strategy
tips.body: Set the infeed (stepover) distance for roughing based on tool reference point and path.

tips.title: Set retract strategy for roughing
tips.body: For roughing, the retract movement is always linear.

tips.title: Set retract strategy for finishing
tips.body: For finishing, the retract movement can be linear or circular.

tips.title: Define zigzag machining
tips.body: Change the machining direction per section following the shortest path.

tips.title: Use inclined plunging motion
tips.body: Achieve an inclined plunging motion with the plunge angle.

tips.title: Set clearance plane and distance
tips.body: Limit areas for rapid tool movements by setting the clearance plane and distance.

tips.title: Enable collision check for all tool components
tips.body: Check tool shank, holder, and extension in addition to the tip.

tips.title: Define clearance plane for rapid movements
tips.body: Set the clearance plane by right-clicking on the icon and selecting a point.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for infeed control
tips.body: Define the clearance distance to control infeed above and below the plane.

tips.title: Specify vertical machining area limits
tips.body: Set the top and bottom values for the workpiece's Z-axis limits.

tips.title: Use manual top and bottom for precise control
tips.body: Manually specify top and bottom values directly on the model.

tips.title: Limit vertical stepdown for material allowance
tips.body: Set the number of machining planes and remaining material allowance.

tips.title: Calculate negative stock allowances carefully
tips.body: Ensure the sum of negative stock allowance and tool corner radius does not become negative.

tips.title: Use horizontal stepover for infeed control
tips.body: Specify the infeed length dimension or factor of tool diameter.

tips.title: Set retract mode for collision-free movements
tips.body: Define the Z level where horizontal infeed moves are executed.

tips.title: Use climb milling for clockwise rotating tools
tips.body: Select conventional milling for anti-clockwise rotating tools.

tips.title: Define boundaries for machining area
tips.body: Use boundary curves, milling surfaces, or stop surfaces to define the area.

tips.title: Avoid overlapping machining areas
tips.body: Ensure machining areas do not overlap and are not too close together.

tips.title: Use manual boundaries for precise control
tips.body: Manually define boundaries using Polylines, Splines, or Circles.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to exclude machining areas
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to define areas where no machining takes place.

tips.title: Set offset for stop surfaces
tips.body: Extend the area excluded from machining by specifying an offset value.

tips.title: Define boundary surfaces for soft bounding
tips.body: Use ball mills and set blending factor between 0.02 and 0.2 based on tool radius.

tips.title: Select boundary surfaces manually or use 'All other surfaces'
tips.body: Choose stop surfaces manually or set all areas not defined as milling surfaces.

tips.title: Use manual tool reference for boundary subdivision
tips.body: Define traverse area based on boundary curve using 'Toward', 'Offset', 'Past', or 'Contact' methods.

tips.title: Set boundary projection direction manually or automatically
tips.body: Project boundary in any desired direction using 'Userdefined projection direction' or 'Reverse' option.

tips.title: Define plunge macros for infeed movement
tips.body: Available strategies include 'Axial', 'Helical', and 'Ramp'. Each has specific parameters.

tips.title: Define macros for profile-oriented machining
tips.body: Available methods include 'Profile-oriented machining' and 'Level-by-level machining'. Define parameters as needed.

tips.title: Define macros for setup and stock model
tips.body: Set required model and stock, considering multiple allowances if applicable.

tips.title: Use temporary safety surfaces for additional machining
tips.body: To avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements, create temporary safety surfaces.

tips.title: Create stock models for subsequent machining tasks
tips.body: Generate a stock model to ensure accurate subsequent machining operations.

tips.title: Avoid unnecessary empty paths in undercut areas
tips.body: Use undercut trimming to prevent unnecessary empty paths during multi-axis stock indexing.

tips.title: Enable tool check for collision avoidance
tips.body: Always enable the 'Check on' option to ensure the tool is checked for collisions.

tips.title: Define clearance value for tool components
tips.body: Set the clearance value to be at least twice the required distance between the model and the tool.

tips.title: Use 'Reduce' option for tool length calculation
tips.body: The 'Reduce' option calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach.

tips.title: Use 'Extend' option for tool length calculation
tips.body: The 'Extend' option calculates a larger tool reach based on the tool reach defined for the tool.

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions in machining strategies
tips.body: For unresolvable collisions, use options like Stop, Clip, Collision avoidance, or rework machining.

tips.title: Check for collisions in areas outside the stock
tips.body: Ensure that any area outside the stock also contains a shroud surface to check for collisions.

tips.title: Use 'Clip' option for 3D Rework Machining
tips.body: The 'Clip' option calculates toolpaths that are used as the basis for the 3D Rework Machining cycle.

tips.title: Use 'Min. distance G0' for minor surface gaps
tips.body: Bridging minor surface gaps and traversing small inside boundaries using the minimum distance G0.

tips.title: Set 'Min. G0 distance' for toolpath optimization
tips.body: Define the minimum distance between two machining areas to avoid rapid movements.

tips.title: Use ball mills, end mills, and bullnose end mills for Arbitrary Stock Roughing
tips.body: Available tools include ball mills, end mills, and bullnose end mills for Z constant machining.

tips.title: Use bullnose end mills with caution
tips.body: Material ridges may remain standing when using bullnose endmills due to the total tool diameter.

tips.title: Consider corner radius when using bullnose end mills
tips.body: Set the infeed distance based on the tool's inner shank to avoid material ridges.

tips.title: Use tapered tools for Arbitrary Stock Roughing
tips.body: Tapered tools are supported, and the cone angle defines the tool's shape.

tips.title: Select machining direction based on main extension
tips.body: Base the selection of the machining direction on the main extension of the machining area.

tips.title: Use 'Contour parallel' for machining parallel to the contour
tips.body: Machining is carried out parallel to the contour with vertical stepover.

tips.title: Optimize stock removal with 'Pocket' strategy
tips.body: Stock removal is carried out with infeed optimisation, machining cavities in sequence.

tips.title: Inside-out stock removal
tips.body: Stock removal takes place parallel to the contour from the inside outwards.

tips.title: Rapid in stock removal
tips.body: Redundant paths resulting from the boundary are traversed in rapid mode.

tips.title: Optimized in stock removal
tips.body: Optimizes retract movements and avoids unnecessary milling movements for complex models.

tips.title: Horizontal infeed radius
tips.body: Executes horizontal infeed between tool paths with an approach and departure radius.

tips.title: Fillet radius for toolpaths
tips.body: Rounds abrupt changes in direction within the cutting toolpaths with a specified radius.

tips.title: Climb milling as preferred mode
tips.body: Climb milling is the preferred cutting mode for arbitrary stock roughing.

tips.title: Reduce feedrate during full cut
tips.body: Reduces feedrate to avoid causing damage to the tool from high cutting forces.

tips.title: Allowance and additional allowance XY
tips.body: Defines stock allowances for different parts of the machining area.

tips.title: Max step height for large axial infeeds
tips.body: Enables initial downwards vertical step down and removes remaining material according to the defined Max step height.

tips.title: Plane level detection for vertical stepdown
tips.body: Controls the strategy based on workpiece surface, suitable for sloped walls and flat transitions.

tips.title: Automatic intermediate levels for planar surfaces
tips.body: Inserts intermediate levels with smaller vertical stepdown values for planar surfaces around the entire workpiece circumference.

tips.title: Optimized infeeds for smoother machine movements
tips.body: Reduces tool wear and tear by using smooth, stretched infeeds between single equidistant cuts.

tips.title: Minimal stock removal for collision avoidance
tips.body: Enables automatic collision avoidance if the material width is lower than the defined value.

tips.title: Finish pass all levels for minor changes
tips.body: Ensures tool moves along defined contour even if no material is cleared.

tips.title: Retract mode for clearance
tips.body: Controls the tool's movement during repositioning without material removal.

tips.title: High Performance Mode for constant load
tips.body: Characterized by constant load on the tool and machine during machining sequence.

tips.title: Opening cut for narrow areas
tips.body: Enables opening of narrow, inaccessible areas with several vertical stepdowns.

tips.title: Side mill only for narrow areas
tips.body: Enables opening of narrow, inaccessible areas with trochoidal movements.

tips.title: Fillet radius for High Performance Mode
tips.body: Must be at least 5% of the tool diameter.

tips.title: Safety during repositioning
tips.body: Controls axial movement away from the plane currently being machined.

tips.title: Dense area stepover for trochoidal movements
tips.body: Reduces horizontal stepover in narrow areas, particularly useful for hard materials.

tips.title: Plunge feedrate for closed pockets
tips.body: Minimum feedrate for plunge movement in closed pockets that cannot be accessed from the outside.

tips.title: Control lateral approach with Factor side entry
tips.body: Factor side entry regulates the lateral approach from outside and is referenced to the feedrate XY of the tool.

tips.title: Adjust plunge entry for helical or ramp plunge
tips.body: Factor plunge entry affects the helical or ramp plunge into the material from above, calculated with plunge feedrate.

tips.title: Reduce opposite direction feedrate for climb milling
tips.body: For climb milling, the opposite direction feedrate is reduced by a specified factor (e.g., 0.8 for 20% reduction).

tips.title: Use zigzag feedrate for climb milling
tips.body: In climb milling, the opposite direction feedrate is reduced by a specified factor (e.g., 0.8 for 20% reduction).

tips.title: Limitations in High Performance Mode
tips.body: In High Performance Mode, standard functions like pocket sorting are limited or unavailable.

tips.title: Default machining sequence
tips.body: By default, stock removal of cavities or pockets takes place level-by-level.

tips.title: Planar mode optimization
tips.body: Infeed is performed optimised in planar mode.

tips.title: Climb milling always used
tips.body: Machining is always performed using climb milling.

tips.title: Dynamic feedrate adjustment
tips.body: Feedrates are adjusted dynamically to the machining conditions during full cut.

tips.title: Separate feedrate for opening cut
tips.body: A separate feedrate can be defined for the opening cut in High Performance Mode.

tips.title: Toolpath fillets for abrupt changes
tips.body: All toolpaths are rounded for abrupt changes of direction.

tips.title: Helical or ramp plunge macro
tips.body: A complete helical or ramp movement always occurs for the plunge macro, where the angle is reduced dynamically.

tips.title: Avoidance of collision in plunge points
tips.body: Collision avoidance is not supported for unresolvable collisions.

tips.title: Parametric feedrate output not supported
tips.body: Parametric feedrate output is not supported in the NC file.

tips.title: Define start of machining with plunge points
tips.body: One or more boundaries are permitted that may be one inside the other to limit the area.

tips.title: Use groove limit for machining area
tips.body: Limit the machining area to grooves.

tips.title: Helix radius determined automatically
tips.body: The Helix radius parameter is not available; it is determined automatically according to the particular machining situation.

tips.title: Continuous ramping-in movement for closed pockets
tips.body: In High Performance Mode, the ramp plunge macro generates a continuous ramping-in movement without reversing direction.

tips.title: Define pilot hole diameter
tips.body: Specify the pilot hole diameter with the drill diameter; value must be at least 1.25* tool diameter and 1.1* tool diameter + 4* stock tolerance.

tips.title: Define pilot hole angle
tips.body: Specify the pilot hole angle with the hole angle; this corresponds to the tip angle of the tool being used.

tips.title: Define minimum pocket size
tips.body: Define the minimum size for pockets that can be machined with the specific tool; standard: 3.5 * tool radius.

tips.title: Ignore small pockets option
tips.body: If the Ignore small pockets option is enabled, the default value for the Min. pocket size (3.5 * tool radius) is set.

tips.title: Stop before execution
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Using minimum G0 distance
tips.body: Defines the maximum distance between two machining surfaces, which can be traversed without tool contact.

tips.title: Bridging minor surface gaps
tips.body: Protects the machine ramps against overstressing by eliminating minor rapid movements.

tips.title: Traversing of small inside boundaries
tips.body: Protects the machine ramps against overstressing by eliminating minor rapid movements.

tips.title: Protection of machine ramps
tips.body: Eliminates minor rapid movements to protect the machine ramps against overstressing.

tips.title: Use Adaptive Pocket strategy for efficient roughing
tips.body: Adaptive Pocket fits rectangular and circular pockets into the roughing area, enabling high-speed cutting with reduced direction changes.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutter types for roughing
tips.body: Ball mills cannot use the Adaptive Pocket option, while end mill, bullnose end mill, and lollipop cutters can be used.

tips.title: Enable High feed machining for large lateral infeed
tips.body: High feed machining is available only with the Adaptive Pocket strategy, allowing large lateral but small vertical infeed and high feedrate.

tips.title: Set lateral infeed based on scallop height
tips.body: For Adaptive Pocket machining, a lateral infeed greater than 50% of the tool diameter is possible.

tips.title: Smooth toolpaths with fillets
tips.body: Use fillet radius to smooth transitions between tool paths and model contours.

tips.title: Define machining area manually if needed
tips.body: Manually specify the top and bottom values for the machining area by clicking icons on the model.

tips.title: Reduce feedrate during full cut to avoid tool damage
tips.body: Enable the Reduce feedrate during full cut parameter to reduce cutting forces and prevent tool damage.

tips.title: Set stepover factor for horizontal infeed
tips.body: Horizontal stepover factor defines the horizontal stepover as a factor of the milling tool diameter.

tips.title: Define stock allowance for subsequent finish machining
tips.body: Allowance specifies the remaining material to be removed in subsequent finish machining.

tips.title: Use Auto option for plane level detection
tips.body: Auto option inserts an intermediate step with a smaller vertical stepdown value for planar surfaces if the defined vertical stepdown is greater than the distance between two workpiece surfaces.

tips.title: Select surfaces to avoid machining from tool axis perspective
tips.body: Avoid areas that the tool holder may damage when defining surfaces not to be machined.

tips.title: Display boundaries rest material areas in graphical preview
tips.body: Activate the Boundaries rest material areas function to display rest material areas as contour's bounding box.

tips.title: Display collision boundaries in graphical preview
tips.body: Activate the Collision boundaries function to display areas where collisions with tool holder or shank were identified as limitation contours.

tips.title: Define model and stock
tips.body: Specify the required model and stock for machining operations.

tips.title: Set plunge macro angle
tips.body: Specify an angle for plunging the tool into the material using a spiral shape.

tips.title: Define clearance feedrate
tips.body: Set the clearance feedrate for linking movements between each infeed without material removal.

tips.title: Set machining tolerance
tips.body: Enter the required tolerance for the calculation of toolpath generation.

tips.title: Use ball mill for scallop height mode
tips.body: Ball mills are supported in scallop height mode during Profile Finishing.

tips.title: Use bullnose endmill for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: Bullnose endmills and ball mills are supported for slope-dependent machining.

tips.title: Select tool and define parameters
tips.body: Choose a suitable cutter type (ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, lollipop) and set tool parameters.

tips.title: Define infeed strategy profile
tips.body: Set the tool movements via a profile definition (standard profiles, free profiles).

tips.title: Set machining angle
tips.body: Enter the rotation angle required for machining based on guide curves.

tips.title: Reverse milling and infeed directions
tips.body: Customize the milling and infeed direction for optimal adjustments to the milling paths.

tips.title: Limit machining area with boundary
tips.body: Define a boundary to limit the machining area when using guide curves.

tips.title: Use free profile as guide curve
tips.body: Compute toolpaths according to the horizontal stepover and equidistant from the guide curve.

tips.title: Machining from outside in for closed guide curves
tips.body: Perform machining from the outside in when using closed guide curves.

tips.title: Calculate profiles perpendicular to guide curve
tips.body: Profiles are calculated perpendicularly to the guide curve, with the limiting boundary determining profile length.

tips.title: Reverse direction for opposed guide curves
tips.body: Reverse the direction of one guide curve if they are in an opposed direction.

tips.title: Use tool reference parameters for guide curves
tips.body: Control the behavior of the tool at guide curves using boundary dialogue page.

tips.title: Define offset area for machining
tips.body: Use from and to parameters to define a distance within which machining will take place.

tips.title: Use closed contours as pocket profiles
tips.body: Closed 3D contours can be used as pocket profiles for finishing pre-machined pockets.

tips.title: Set fillet radius for toolpaths
tips.body: Changes in direction within the toolpaths are rounded with the specified radius.

tips.title: Adapt infeed direction to contour
tips.body: Use the Inside-out or Outside-in parameter to adapt the infeed direction to the contour.

tips.title: Adapt cutting mode to contour
tips.body: Use the Climb milling or Conventional milling parameter to adapt the cutting mode.

tips.title: Set offset for pre-machined contour
tips.body: Specify the existing material width on the machining contour in connection with pre-machined pockets.

tips.title: Set type of cut for profile finishing
tips.body: Ascending for roughing close to surface, Descending for recess machining, Up and down for standard finishing

tips.title: Choose infeed mode for profile finishing
tips.body: Zigzag direct or Zigzag smooth, depending on the need for correction by macros and clearance distance

tips.title: Define machining area for profile finishing
tips.body: Automatically recognized or manually limited in Z direction using Manual top or Manual bottom functions

tips.title: Set vertical infeed mode for profile finishing
tips.body: Only finishing, Constant vertical stepdown, or Parallel vertical stepdown based on requirements

tips.title: Use boundary for machining strategy
tips.body: Limit machining area with boundary curve or milling surfaces, soft bounding available for ball mills

tips.title: Define tool reference for profile finishing
tips.body: Contact with option to offset boundary, on, past, or normal infeed strategy

tips.title: Use macros for approach and retract in profile finishing
tips.body: Vertical, Circular, Tangential, Ramp options available for approach and retract macros

tips.title: Enable return macro for profile finishing
tips.body: Executes horizontal stepover via clearance plane or distance, executes approach or retract macros

tips.title: 3D Path Compensation
tips.body: Available for Ball mill tool type. Allows different NC programs to machine using a smaller or larger tool than programmed in hyperMILL, with an allowance of up to 10% of the cutter diameter.

tips.title: Z Level Finishing Strategy
tips.body: Machining sequence options include Plane, Pocket, and Ramp connect. Spiral connect is not supported for slope-dependent machining.

tips.title: Infeed Mode Options
tips.body: Rapid, Direct, and Smooth infeed modes are available for controlling stepdown to the next level within a machining area.

tips.title: Cutting Mode Options
tips.body: Slope mode excludes areas with small slope angles from machining, requiring manual exclusion for flat areas.

tips.title: Vertical Infeed Mode Options
tips.body: Constant stepdown and scallop height options are available for defining the distance between NC paths.

tips.title: Path Compensation Warning
tips.body: If the compensated path option is enabled and Return macro disabled, a warning is given and the return macro is activated.

tips.title: Boundary Definition
tips.body: One or more boundaries are permitted that may be inside each other to limit the machining area; however, they may not be nested several times.

tips.title: Plunge Point Definition
tips.body: Enable to define the XY coordinates at which infeed in Z takes place onto the next finishing level; if not enabled, hyperMILL automatically looks for the point with the greatest milling depth.

tips.title: Define one plunge point for Z Level Finishing cycle
tips.body: A single plunge point can be defined manually for each cycle. All areas to be machined must be approachable from this point.

tips.title: Enable stock to trim toolpaths
tips.body: Trim to stock: Enable to use the stock to trim the toolpaths. A defined Offset value is taken into account.

tips.title: Use macros for approach and retract
tips.body: Approach and retract macros are used to define the tool approach at the start point and the tool retraction from the end point of the machining.

tips.title: Set macro mode to automatic or manual
tips.body: Macro mode: Automatic: The approach and retract macros are calculated automatically. Manual: Define the approach and retract macros manually.

tips.title: Configure tool movements for approach and retract
tips.body: Approach macro / Retract macro: Smooth, Length, Lateral/Axial clearance, Max. axial lift.

tips.title: Enable return macro for horizontal stepover
tips.body: Return macro: If Return macro is enabled, horizontal stepover is executed between the milling paths via the clearance plane or clearance distance.

tips.title: Use 3D radius compensation for ball mill tools
tips.body: Use 3D radius compensation: The function is available for the Ball mill tool type and allows machining with a smaller or larger tool than programmed.

tips.title: Set maximum compensation value for 3D radius compensation
tips.body: Max. compensation value: The value should be no more than 10% of the cutter diameter.

tips.title: Select appropriate tool types for Shape level finishing
tips.body: The following cutter types can be used: ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill and lollipop.

tips.title: Define machining options for Shape level finishing
tips.body: Edges only: Only available for the Shape offset mode. Side walls : all lateral walls will be machined in multiple axial infeeds.

tips.title: Configure machining sequence for Shape level finishing
tips.body: Axial sorting: Areas like corners or pockets are sorted axially and machined consecutively.

tips.title: Set parameters for Shape level finishing
tips.body: Slope mode: Exclude areas with small slope angles from machining.

tips.title: Configure clearance parameters for Shape level finishing
tips.body: Side clearance: Minimum distance in lateral direction from the surface of the model.

tips.title: Use ISO lines for optimal surface flow
tips.body: Milling paths follow ISO lines (U, V) to ensure smooth and efficient machining.

tips.title: Ensure surfaces meet without gaps for Iso Machining
tips.body: Neighbouring surfaces must flow into each other smoothly to avoid gaps.

tips.title: Select appropriate tool orientation for machining direction
tips.body: For Iso orientation, define the machining direction and infeed direction using U or V parameters.

tips.title: Use Global orientation for parallel or crossway machining
tips.body: Global orientation allows milling paths to run crossways or parallel to the longest boundary curve.

tips.title: Define infeed mode for stepover between milling paths
tips.body: Set the direction of horizontal stepover between individual milling paths based on selected ISO line.

tips.title: Use uniform or symmetric path grouping for Iso Machining
tips.body: Available only for ISO orientation, paths can be distributed uniformly or symmetrically.

tips.title: Define start and end points for contours
tips.body: Each contour can be assigned a start and end point for partial machining.

tips.title: Use Trochoidal stepover for smoother machining
tips.body: Trochoidal stepover provides a smooth infeed along the selected contour.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to limit machining area
tips.body: Stop surfaces can be used to limit the machining area and prevent overcutting.

tips.title: Use approach and retract macros for controlled tool movements
tips.body: Perpendicular, circular, tangential, ramp, and macro options are available for approach and retract behavior.

tips.title: Adjust check tolerance for model geometry
tips.body: Set the check tolerance as a factor of the tool radius to avoid unnecessary retraction movements at vertical walls. Permitted values: 2*Machining tolerance ≥ Check tolerance ≥ Machining tolerance.

tips.title: Enable tool path compensation for repointed tools
tips.body: Enable 2D path compensation if repointed tools are used, ensuring the toolpath can be machined without collisions.

tips.title: Define machining area and boundary behavior
tips.body: Set the horizontal machining area and border behavior of the tool at the machining limits using the Boundary option.

tips.title: Use stock model for trimming toolpaths
tips.body: Enable the stock option to use a stockmodel for trimming toolpaths on the stock.

tips.title: Set finish allowance for final pass
tips.body: Define the finish allowance to specify material removed during a final finish pass.

tips.title: Adjust stepover for horizontal infeed mode
tips.body: Set the horizontal stepover as a length dimension or factor of the tool diameter for infeed movements in the machining plane.

tips.title: Enable stock allowance for additional material removal
tips.body: Set the stock allowance to specify remaining material on the workpiece in the direction of surface normals.

tips.title: Define fillet radius for toolpaths
tips.body: Set the fillet radius to round abrupt changes in direction within cutting toolpaths, preventing excessive tool wrapping and load.

tips.title: Set retract mode for horizontal infeed movements
tips.body: Define the Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for infeed movements
tips.body: Set the clearance distance to control when infeed takes place as rapid or at Z feedrate.

tips.title: Select machining mode for Complete Finishing
tips.body: Choose between All areas, Steep areas, or Flat areas for slope-dependent machining.

tips.title: Set slope angle for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: Define the slope angle to delimit steep and flat areas based on surface gradient.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for transition areas
tips.body: Set the smooth overlap option to ensure a high level of surface quality in the transition area between flat and steep surfaces.

tips.title: Use zigzag mode for machining
tips.body: Select the Zigzag mode to perform machining with alternating orientation between steep and flat areas.

tips.title: Define connect factor for linking movements
tips.body: Set the connect factor to control the length of linking movements between infeed planes.

tips.title: Set lateral/axial clearance for macros
tips.body: Define the clearance in the axial or X/Y direction that can be travelled without collision.

tips.title: Define maximum axial lift for macros
tips.body: Set the maximum lifting movement in the axial direction.

tips.title: Create surface group using Exclude surfaces function
tips.body: Use the shortcut menu of the Exclude surfaces function icon to create a Surface Group feature.

tips.title: Use Equidistant Finishing Strategy
tips.body: Machining with constant infeed to ensure high surface quality and reduce cutter load, suitable for high-speed milling.

tips.title: Define Connect Factor for Toolpath Connection
tips.body: Connect factor determines the length and rounding of the ramp between planes, calculated as tool diameter x connect factor.

tips.title: Use Spiral Infeed Mode for Equidistant Finishing
tips.body: Interpolates toolpaths to form a spiral-like movement, suitable for further information in section Infeed mode.

tips.title: Select Appropriate Approach and Retract Macros
tips.body: Available macros include Axial, Circular, and Tangential for approach and retract movements without causing collisions.

tips.title: Define Machining Area for Form Pocket
tips.body: Use Top and Depth to define the vertical machining area, with a reference plane through pockets to be machined.

tips.title: Set Helix Radius and Angle for Form Pocket
tips.body: Helix radius is the offset of the cutter center point relative to the Z axis through the plunge point, angle defines lead angle.

tips.title: Ignore Small Pockets During Calculation
tips.body: To protect the tool, pockets smaller than or equal to the tool radius are not machined.

tips.title: Select reference tool diameter
tips.body: The reference tool diameter should be up to 20% greater than the machining tool diameter.

tips.title: Define machining depth and stepover
tips.body:
Machining depth: Depth of grooves.
Vertical stepdown: Define the number of machining passes.

tips.title: Set up automatic rest machining
tips.body: Remachining of separate rest material areas left during a finishing cycle.

tips.title: Select reference tool for automatic rest machining
tips.body: The reference tool is used for the computation of the rest material areas.

tips.title: Define cavity depth for automatic rest machining
tips.body: Defines the depth from which the machining mode switches to cavity mode.

tips.title: Define machining area manually
tips.body: Use Manual top /Manual bottom functions to limit the machining area.

tips.title: Set infeed mode
tips.body: Choose between Smooth and Direct modes for the infeed motion.

tips.title: Adjust max cutting depth
tips.body: Set the Max. cutting depth parameter to avoid tool breakages.

tips.title: Enable roughing mode
tips.body: Activate the Roughing mode to machine rest material areas.

tips.title: Define boundary for machining area
tips.body: Use Boundary curve or Milling surfaces strategies to define the machining area.

tips.title: Activate parallel sorting for rest material paths
tips.body: Enable parallel sorting to shorten paths and make rest material areas cohesive.

tips.title: Use ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill for rework machining
tips.body: Select appropriate cutter types like ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Set stock allowance for rework machining
tips.body: Define the remaining allowance on the model for rework machining.

tips.title: Enable parallel sorting for rework machining paths
tips.body: Activate parallel sorting to combine interrupted Rework Machining paths.

tips.title: Use bullnose end mills and ball mills for rib/groove machining
tips.body: Select appropriate cutter types like bullnose end mills and ball mills.

tips.title: Define machining sequence for rib/groove machining
tips.body: Choose between Z-level and Pocket machining sequences.

tips.title: Set bottom height for rib/groove machining
tips.body: Define the height of the floor area to be machined in Bottom only mode.

tips.title: Enable boundary projection for machining area definition
tips.body: Project the defined boundary in any desired direction to limit the machining area.

tips.title: Set bottom machining for rib/groove machining
tips.body: Enable Bottom machining for the Bottom only machining mode.

tips.title: Enable small grooves more precise
tips.body: Increase accuracy for narrow areas during machining.

tips.title: Set minimum pocket size
tips.body: Minimum size for pockets that can be machined with a tool, default is 3.5 * tool radius.

tips.title: Use stop before execution
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Define minimum rest material height
tips.body: Areas with a smaller rest material height are not machined.

tips.title: Set resolution value
tips.body: The resolution factor determines the accuracy in defining rest material areas, recommended values between 0.25 and 0.5.

tips.title: Enable avoid shank collision
tips.body: Use when using tapered tools with a shank to avoid collision of the tool shank with the stock.

tips.title: Select machining mode for contours
tips.body: Specify the machining mode for contours, options include Manual curves, Surface mode with Surfaces, and Rest material machining.

tips.title: Set preferred start point/end point for contours
tips.body: Enable if only sections of a contour should be machined, select start and end points.

tips.title: Enable optimise start points for closed contours
tips.body: Automatically search for the best starting points that will facilitate a collision-free standard macro.

tips.title: Set machining depth for contours
tips.body: Define the machining depth of the contour.

tips.title: Enable Z-smoothing for contours
tips.body: Use to smooth the toolpath in case of insufficient contour quality.

tips.title: Enable oneway machining for contours
tips.body: Machining always in the same orientation.

tips.title: Enable zigzag machining for contours
tips.body: Machining with alternating orientation.

tips.title: Enable Z-constant machining for contours
tips.body: Remaining rest material areas from a preceding roughing operation will be z-constant machined.

tips.title: Set total infeed for contours
tips.body: Total infeed in the XY plane.

tips.title: Enable spring path for contours
tips.body: Machine the entire defined contour, even if no more material will be cleared.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for retract mode
tips.body: Vertical retract movements to the next infeed are executed at the height of the axial clearance.

tips.title: Enable trim to stock for macros
tips.body: Use the stock to trim the toolpaths, a defined Offset is taken into account.

tips.title: Set ramp height for approach macro
tips.body: Define the height of the ramp for the approach movement.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for approach macro
tips.body: Define the angle of the ramp for the approach movement.

tips.title: Set ramp length for approach macro
tips.body: Define the length of the ramp for the approach movement.

tips.title: Set feedrate approach/retract for macros
tips.body: Define the feedrate for the approach and retract movement.

formulas.name: Various geometric parameters of features
formulas.expression: Simple Hole, Sink Hole, Free defined hole, pocket (for use in contour milling cycle) and planes can be defined using a formula.
